fusions.name: Unfiltered
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt of musk and raw arcana at the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sympathetic Reek
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts of musk-laced arcana in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each bolt deals 6 damage, and your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Carries Further
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 65% further.

fusions.name: Residue as Reagent
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
